# David Swift

> David builds and backs ventures that expand opportunity for future generations and extend the hope and horizons of intelligent life.

Canonical page: https://davidswift.xyz/

David Swift is an entrepreneur, would be technologist and long-horizon founder building ventures, startups and human capability for a more intelligent future. Raised in the UK and now based in Dubai, he has built across technology, enterprise and agriculture. Whole-systems thinking taught him to look beyond the immediate cycle: to connect decisions, consequences and opportunities across decades.

His mission is to provision humanity with the knowledge, technologies and systems that help future generations thrive, on Earth and eventually for intelligent life beyond it.

## Work

- Regenerative: Sustainable future crops and low-carbon technologies: carbon credits and green energy engineered to prove their value in the world now. Ventures: MacroAgri, Plant Force Britain.
- Intelligence: Education, applied intelligence and human systems that expand what people are capable of learning, building and becoming. Venture: Superintelligence.
- Enterprise 2.0: Precision technology, manufacturing and patient capital shaping how the next century builds, funds and scales. Venture: Elektra.

## Horizon

- Years 0 to 25, Prove: Current technology ventures, useful systems and ideas that earn their place in the world now.
- Years 25+, Carry: Knowledge, human capability and enduring communities that take the work further.
- Years 70+, Beyond: The framework for intelligent life beyond Earth, built on everything the first century makes possible.

## Values

Curiosity, Growth, Optimism.
